_eligibility_text: - The applicant must be a permanent resident of Gujarat. - The applicant must be aspiring for recruitment in Army, Air Force, Navy, Paramilitary Forces or Police Forces. - The applicant must meet the age criteria as prescribed for respective defence and police services. - The applicant must possess minimum educational qualifications as required for the specific service examination they are preparing for. - The applicant must have completed relevant educational requirements as per Central Government norms for defence services. - The applicant must meet basic physical fitness standards for defence and police services. - The applicant must be medically fit as per general health requirements. - The applicant must be willing to undergo rigorous physical training programs. - The applicant must belong to economically weaker sections or demonstrate financial need for training assistance. - The applicant must not be receiving similar training assistance from other government schemes simultaneously.
